jobs.description:
**Curious, hands-on and happiest in SQL? Join our Implementation team and turn raw data from some of the biggest retailers in the US into actions frontline teams actually use.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We usually respond within two weeks

**ABOUT QUORSO**
----------------

Quorso is one of retail's most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalized daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we're scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.

Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers rewire how they make operational decisions. Using Quorso's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn terabytes of raw store data into personalized, actionable insights, sent in near real time directly to frontline users.

We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now growing our Implementation team in the US to support new global growth.

#### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

In your first six months at Quorso, you will help rewire how global retail giants like Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply, and Circle K make operational decisions. You’ll work with terabytes of real-world store data, help find millions in operational savings, and turn them into personalized, actionable insights across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. You won’t be maintaining dashboards or sending email reports hoping someone will read them. Instead, you’ll work at the heart of near real-time, targeted, data-driven actions, sent directly to frontline users.

The best part of this role, and the hardest, is the application. Retail data reaches us raw and unstructured, and you will build pipelines to clean, join supplementary data and write logic to power the application , creating this in SQL. Once customers are live, you support and enhance the configuration, investigating failure alerts, handling support requests, and partnering with colleagues to develop new data flows. This is data-shaping, exception finding, and data-led operations at scale.

You’ll learn alongside experienced implementation leads. Learn new systems, contribute to and enhance new ways of working, and let your curiosity flourish. Implementation is a team of individuals striving to push the bounds of what is possible.

This is a fully remote role based in the US. We can only consider candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones, to ensure good working-hours overlap with both our US and UK-based teams, including the Director of Implementation.

#### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Manage retail data from enterprise clients, shaping it in SQL into something usable: cleaning, joins, restructuring and layering on predefined and bespoke logic.
* Monitor live customers for data failures and use case up-time, investigating issues in SQL and fixing or escalating them.
* Manage support requests across customers and escalate to the appropriate channels.
* Work with customer teams and senior Implementation colleagues to understand client operations and build data-led use cases.
* Configure Quorso’s application to highlight store performance, flag improvement opportunities and measure results.
* Work with Product, Customer and Implementation team members to create a constant learning and improvement feedback loop that connects to business priorities.

#### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* Hands-on SQL used to transform data, with and without AI assistance: joins, CTEs, window functions, and restructuring multi-source data. Be ready to walk us through a specific query you have written and the problem it solved. Shortlisted candidates will also be asked to complete a live SQL test.
* Experience working with large datasets and reading SQL written by others.
* The ability to turn a business problem into a well-thought-out, scalable query.

#### **EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE**

* Retail, FMCG or other operational data experience.
* Experience improving processes or influencing decisions through data.
* Experience working with HTML.
* Experience in a support or operations environment.

#### **IS THIS YOU?**

* You reach for SQL to solve a data problem before you reach for anything else.
* You love learning new products and tools, and when one doesn’t exist or doesn’t work the way you need, your instinct is to vibe code something that does.
* You are relentlessly curious, and you default to solving problems rather than reporting on them.
* You enjoy tracing a broken number back to its root cause and making sure it stays fixed.
* You enjoy working with data, working directly with stakeholders, and turning analysis into measurable impact.
* You stay accurate and organised when juggling several customers and requests at once.

#### **PAY AND BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this role is $90k - $110k per year. The final offer will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience and location.

Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; other benefits.

#### **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**

Quorso is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on the skills, experience and potential people bring to the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.

If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.

#### **About the role**

Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the customer relationship from handover to go-live, guiding hotels through setup, training and rollout so the platform works for them from day one. Each go-live is the first real test of whether Mews fits the way a property runs, and the quality of that experience shapes whether a customer stays and grows with us. Mews serves hotels across EMEA, and the portfolio is large enough that how well you onboard is felt in the numbers.

As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you run several mid-market and enterprise implementations at the same time, often phased across multiple properties or regions. You work with customer stakeholders on one side and with Sales, Support and RevOps on the other, so that what was agreed in the sale is what gets delivered at go-live.

The problem this role solves sits in the period between signing and a working go-live. Configuration choices, integration issues and timeline slips that surface late are costly for the customer and for us. You spot them early, make risk-informed trade-offs, and give customers credible advice on setup so they adopt the product and are ready to run on it.

**What you would do**

* Run several onboarding projects at once, at different stages and levels of complexity, within SLA targets, including phased rollouts across multiple properties and regions
* Configure the product for each customer, diagnose integration issues, and advise on setup decisions, flagging configuration, data and timeline risks early
* Train customer stakeholders with different needs, drive adoption through to go-live, and keep Sales, Support and RevOps aligned along the way
* Use AI to draft documentation, prepare for customer sessions and keep project tracking efficient
* Check AI-generated material for accuracy before it reaches a customer or colleague, and share what works with the team

**AI Fluency Level 2:** In this role, AI is part of your regular working week, for example drafting customer documentation, preparing for training sessions and keeping project tracking tidy, and it makes you noticeably faster and better at onboarding work. Just as important, you check what it gives you: you read it critically, correct it, and only share it with a customer or colleague once you are sure it is accurate.

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates* *on Confluence.*

**What you would bring**

* 3 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, implementation or customer-facing technical roles
* Experience managing concurrent mid-market or enterprise implementations, including phased rollouts across multiple properties or regions
* Deep SaaS product knowledge: you can configure complex products, diagnose integration issues and advise customers credibly on setup decisions
* Strong communication and training skills for diverse customer stakeholders, stakeholder management across customers, Sales, Support and RevOps, and structured project management across several projects at once
* AI Fluency Level 2 in your day-to-day work, with strong discernment: you critically evaluate AI output before sharing it with customers or colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience in hospitality technology or an adjacent sector (hotel management, PMS, POS, payments), or familiarity with Mews Hospitality Cloud or a comparable multi-module SaaS platform
* Multilingual, relevant for EMEA portfolio coverage
* Experience contributing to onboarding playbooks, SOPs or team knowledge bases, or using AI tools to draft training materials, automate repetitive documentation or manage project tracking

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

#### **What's in it for you?**

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

#### **Global benefits**

No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:

* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
* Relocation options, available after one year
* Flexible, hybrid working options
* A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
* Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

#### **Local benefits**

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

#### **Life at Mews**

We're an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

* High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn't a detailed playbook for everything, and that's part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
* Change is constant. We're growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
* We're remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
* AI is an integral part of our processes. It's not here to steal people's jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We're motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

Cofactr is on a mission to empower those who get the critical work done. We're bridging the gaps left by traditional supply chain management solutions, creating a seamless link between Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) through our innovative BOM to Build Platform, specifically tailored for hardware innovators. Our platform revolutionizes the technical hardware supply chain by ensuring it is precise, efficient, and effortlessly manageable. As a proud member of the Y Combinator W22 cohort, we've seen our revenue grow consistently, supported by substantial venture funding from esteemed VCs, including Bain Capital Ventures, including our most recent Series A capital raise of $17.2M.

  

**The Team**

The Cofactr team is innovative, creative, and collaborative, with diverse professional backgrounds and a passion for solving big problems. We’re hiring team members who are energized by the opportunity to make one of the most complex challenges in the world, the global electronics supply chain, into a scalable and intuitive tool. We value transparency and trust among our team and translate this approach into our evolving product.

  

**The Role**

The Sr. Onboarding Project Specialist owns the project management of every new Cofactr customer onboarding, from the moment Sales hands off a closed deal (starting at the end of the sales cycle) through the CSM-led enablement sessions that get the customer's team using the platform. You will run several onboardings at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and configuration requirements, and keep every one of them moving. The value of this role is improving time to value for every new customer while giving them an excellent onboarding experience and making sure they achieve the outcomes they came to Cofactr for. You will get customers from signed contract to configured, enabled, and placing orders faster, without cutting corners on the setup or the relationship.

You are the coordinator between Sales, Customer Success, and the customer. You review what Sales captured in discovery, close the gaps before configuration starts, drive account setup to completion, and line up the enablement sessions our CSMs lead. Your work lets CSMs spend their time on enablement and account growth instead of logistics, and it gets customers to their first purchase (major value milestone) faster. This role requires ***operational rigor***, a **project management mindset**, **strong communication skills**, **cross functional relationship building**, and the discipline to track many concurrent projects without letting one stall.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Sales-to-CS Handoff:** Own the handoff for every new customer. Review the configuration discovery and intake materials from Sales, identify missing requirements, and resolve open questions with Sales and the customer before work begins. Close the knowledge gap.
* **Onboarding Project Management:** Run each onboarding as a project with a defined plan, milestones, owners, and target dates. Track status across all active onboardings and flag risks early.
* **Account Configuration:** Coordinate and complete account setup based on the reviewed requirements, partnering with Support, Product, and Engineering where needs go beyond standard setup.
* **Setup Review:** Lead the account setup review with the customer's main point of contact to confirm the configuration is right before enablement begins.
* **Enablement Coordination:** Schedule and prepare CSM-led enablement sessions and office hours, including attendees, agendas, and customer pre-work, so the CSM can focus on delivering the session and the customer arrives ready.
* **Customer Communication:** Keep customers informed and accountable throughout onboarding with clear next steps, timelines, and recaps.
* **Documentation and Systems:** Keep onboarding records current in our systems (Notion, Salesforce, Pylon) so Sales, CS, and leadership can see where every customer stands.
* **Process Improvement:** Work with CS leadership to refine onboarding playbooks, intake forms, checklists, and templates as volume grows.
* **Metrics and Reporting:** Track onboarding metrics such as time from close to configuration complete, time to first enablement session, time to first purchase, and number of onboardings in flight, and use them to find and remove delays.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, or project management in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.

  + Extra credit for supply chain, procurement, or hardware/manufacturing industry experience
* **Extreme Ownership:** You treat every onboarding as your own from handoff to enablement, and when something stalls, you find the blocker, pull in the right people, and see it through to resolution.
* **Concurrent Project Management:** A track record of running multiple customer projects at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and milestones.
* **Organization and Follow-Through:** You keep a clean tracker, run tight meetings, and close loops without being reminded.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication with customers and internal teams, including the ability to push for decisions and hold stakeholders to dates.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable learning and configuring SaaS platforms, and able to diagnose a setup issue well enough to route it to the right person.
* **Tech Stack Experience:** Familiarity with tools like SFDC, Pylon, Notion, Gainsight, or Metabase; ability to quickly learn new platforms.
* **AI Literacy:** Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work, for example to draft customer communications, summarize calls, build trackers, or automate repetitive steps, and the curiosity to find new ways to apply them to onboarding.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable in an early-stage environment where processes are still being built.

### **Why Join Us**

* **High Impact:** You will own the onboarding experience for every new Cofactr customer, the first impression that sets up their success on the platform.
* **Build Something New:** As the first person in this role, you will shape how Cofactr runs onboarding at scale.
* **Innovative Culture:** Join a collaborative, agile, and innovative team where your ideas and contributions matter.
* **Growth Opportunity:** Collaborate closely with CS leadership and position yourself for expanded scope as the onboarding function matures.
* **Professional Development:** Access mentorship, training, and growth opportunities within a pre-series B company.

  

If you're an organized, detail-oriented professional who likes running projects and keeping customers moving, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to join our growing team and make a meaningful difference!

The Field Training Specialist is responsible for supporting the successful execution of new program rollouts and merchandising initiatives across assigned retail locations. The Field Training Specialist role requires that the incumbent be able to travel within their assigned geography to support hands-on training activities.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Support the coordination and execution of new program launches, merchandising resets, and retail installation initiatives across multiple locations and regions.
* Assist field merchandisers and installation teams with onboarding, training support, project communication, and execution expectations during launch activities.
* Lead field-based training initiatives for installation team leads to improve execution consistency, team readiness, and overall project performance.
* Conduct onsite training and field observations to reinforce best practices, identify performance gaps, and support continuous improvement
* Serve as a point of contact for field team members, supervisors, and store personnel to address questions, provide updates, and resolve issues in real time.
* Monitor daily field activity and project progress to ensure timelines, merchandising standards, and client expectations are met.
* Troubleshoot in-store challenges and help coordinate solutions related to scheduling, staffing, fixtures, product placement, or reporting issues.
* Support launch readiness by ensuring materials, fixtures, signage, and reporting tools are properly distributed and available to field teams.
* Partner with leadership to identify process improvements and opportunities to increase operational efficiency and field execution quality.
* Travel to store locations or regional launches as needed to provide onsite support and operational assistance.
* Build positive relationships with customers, store personnel, vendor partners, and internal teams through professional and responsive communication.
* Comply with all company policies, procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and team support skills
* Excellent organization, time management, and multitasking abilities
* Ability to adapt quickly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable working independently and supporting remote field teams
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow merchandising standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and mobile reporting tools
* Ability to prioritize competing tasks and meet deadlines
* Retail merchandising, field operations, or project coordination experience preferred
* Willingness to travel as needed for launches and field support activities
* Ability to travel regularly to retail locations and launch sites
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 25 pounds as needed during store visits and installations
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including occasional early mornings, evenings, or overnight travel during launch periods

**Experience and Credentials**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* 2–4 years of experience in retail, merchandising, or field operations.
* Prior experience leading, training, or coaching field teams strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry a plus.
* Must have reliable transportation.
  + Must possess a valid state driver's license with proof of current automobile insurance coverage, unless utilizing other means of transportation

  
Compensation: 23-25

With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

The Implementation Consultant II, RCM is a developing professional who plays a key role in helping customers successfully adopt and optimize revenue cycle management solutions. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams, this individual supports system configuration, workflow design, issue resolution, and implementation activities while building expertise in healthcare operations and revenue cycle processes. * Configure billing rules, payer setup, and claim workflows to align with customer requirements and best practices.
* Partner with customers to understand current-state workflows and recommend system configurations that support operational goals.
* Troubleshoot and resolve standard system and process issues, escalating more complex challenges when appropriate.
* Assist with the validation of claims and identification of rejections, denials, and processing errors.
* Document implementation activities, workflows, decisions, and system configurations.
* Communicate effectively with customers, project stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure alignment and progress throughout implementations.
* Monitor implementation milestones and support project deliverables to help ensure successful outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the customer experience.
* Utilize available technology, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, support data-driven decisions, and optimize implementation results.
* Stay current on industry trends, healthcare technology advancements, and revenue cycle best practices to support continuous improvement and innovation.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 2 or more years of experience.
* Experience with system implementation, revenue cycle management (RCM), or healthcare operations.
* Understanding of revenue cycle workflows and processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, systems, and processes quickly.
* Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Detail-oriented approach with a commitment to accuracy in system configuration, validation, and documentation.
* Proven problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate implementation challenges effectively.
* Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Interest in leveraging technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to solve business challenges and improve customer outcomes.
* A growth mindset with the ability to adapt to evolving systems, tools, and business needs.

So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

At **Ensora Health**, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

**About Sailor Health**
-----------------------

Sailor Health is revolutionizing mental health care for older adults, addressing one of the fastest-growing and most underserved healthcare segments in America. With over 60 million seniors expected to make up nearly 25% of the population by 2030, we’re entering a period of unprecedented demand for care. Yet, today, millions of older adults remain isolated, underserved, and struggling with mental health challenges such as anxiety, depression, loneliness without adequate support.

At Sailor Health, we envision a world where every senior has seamless access to compassionate, effective, and personalized mental health care. Join us on our mission to redefine the golden years, enabling older adults across the nation to live happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.

**About the Role**
------------------

**Location:** Remote - US

**Title:** Credentialing Onboarding Specialist

**Salary Range:** $32,000 USD

We’re hiring a full-time remote **Credentialing Onboarding Specialist (CAQH)** to support onboarding aspects of provider credentialing at Sailor Health. You will own end-to-end coordination of provider enrollments & systems access, maintain accurate CAQH profiles, establish SOPs, and monitor credentialing timelines. You’ll join as part of the Provider Onboarding team and work cross-functionally with Credentialing and Payer teams to ensure Sailor’s provider network is compliant, current, and optimized for success.

**Your Key Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

**What You’ll Do**

* **Manage provider system enrollments:** Coordinate with providers to ensure they complete required Medicare enrollment actions, connect to the appropriate profiles and systems, and sign applications and other documents on time.
* **Maintain provider data:** Keep CAQH profiles complete, accurate, and up to date, ensuring provider credentials, licenses, and practice information are properly maintained.
* **Support providers:** Serve as a primary credentialing point of contact for providers, answering questions, communicating required actions, and following up on outstanding items.
* **Monitor enrollment requirements:** Track provider actions, signature requests, correction requests, notices, deadlines, and other outstanding requirements to keep Medicare enrollment moving forward.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Partner with internal stakeholders, including Credentialing and RCM Support, to align priorities, communicate progress, and resolve credentialing and enrollment blockers.
* **Develop and maintain SOPs:** Build, document, and continuously improve standard operating procedures for credentialing workflows and ensure they are incorporated into day-to-day operations.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

This role isn’t for everyone. It’s fast-paced, chaotic, and requires hard work. But if this excites you, we’d love to meet you.

* **Extremely organized, with airtight follow-through.** You catch issues early and never leave something unresolved without a plan to close it out. Colleagues can trust that once something lands with you — in Slack, email, or a call — it's handled, without needing to be reminded.
* **Proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity.** You take initiative without being asked, and when instructions or processes are unclear, you find a path forward and build structure rather than waiting for direction.
* **Sound judgment on urgency and ownership.** You know when something is a drop-everything issue versus one that can wait a few hours, and you know what's yours to solve versus what you should escalate.
* **Warm, empathetic communicator.** You bring genuine warmth to every conversation — clear, kind, and easy to work with, even with a difficult provider on the other end.

**Why Sailor Health**
---------------------

* **Mission with impact.** Help bring life-changing care to a population that’s too often overlooked.
* **Remote-first team.** Enjoy the flexibility of remote work while staying closely connected with a thoughtful, collaborative team rooted in purpose.
* **Growth and ownership.** Be part of a small, agile team where you’ll take initiative, shape key processes, and grow as we grow.
* **Make someone’s day – every day.** Your work helps older adults and their families feel seen, supported, and cared for.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to connect. Join us in redefining what it means to age with dignity, connection, and mental wellness.

jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

**Job Description**

The Implementation Consultant II, RCM is a developing professional who plays a key role in helping customers successfully adopt and optimize revenue cycle management solutions. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams, this individual supports system configuration, workflow design, issue resolution, and implementation activities while building expertise in healthcare operations and revenue cycle processes. The ideal candidate is curious, adaptable, and forward-thinking, with a passion for leveraging technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve customer outcomes, drive operational efficiency, and support successful product adoption.

**What You'll Do**

* Support customer onboarding and implementation activities, ensuring a smooth transition to Ensora solutions.
* Configure billing rules, payer setup, and claim workflows to align with customer requirements and best practices.
* Partner with customers to understand current-state workflows and recommend system configurations that support operational goals.
* Troubleshoot and resolve standard system and process issues, escalating more complex challenges when appropriate.
* Assist with the validation of claims and identification of rejections, denials, and processing errors.
* Document implementation activities, workflows, decisions, and system configurations.
* Communicate effectively with customers, project stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure alignment and progress throughout implementations.
* Monitor implementation milestones and support project deliverables to help ensure successful outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the customer experience.
* Utilize available technology, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, support data-driven decisions, and optimize implementation results.
* Stay current on industry trends, healthcare technology advancements, and revenue cycle best practices to support continuous improvement and innovation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 2 or more years of experience.
* Experience with system implementation, revenue cycle management (RCM), or healthcare operations.
* Understanding of revenue cycle workflows and processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Employment Type:**  
Full time
  
  
**Shift:**  
Day Shift
  
  
**Description:**  
POSITION PURPOSE
  
  
Work Remote Position
  
  
Analyzes health records for documentation compliance in accordance with regulatory and accreditation requirements and medical staff bylaws, rules and regulations. Assists with gathering necessary medical record elements for coding and DNFB encounters. Conducts provider suspension activities and assists with electronic record support for providers. Performs document imaging functions including indexing and validation. Supports Health Information Management (HIM) department functions in a virtual environment, including responding to requests for information from internal and external customers. Validates accuracy of master patient index data and patient demographic data.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  
1. Knows, understands, incorporates, and demonstrates the mission, vision, and values of the Ministry in behaviors, practices, and decisions.
  
  
2. Reviews all discharged inpatient and applicable outpatient records for completeness. Assigns medical record deficiencies in accordance with regulatory and accreditation requirements and medical staff bylaws, rules and regulations.
  
  
3. Validates integrity of patient identification and selection.
  
  
4. Ensures a complete medical record to support hospital operations including patient care and revenue cycle activities.
  
  
5. Performs document imaging functions including indexing and validation.
  
  
6. Operates computer database systems and data used for quality assurance, statistical reporting and/or other purposes. This may include obtaining, clarifying, compiling, interpreting and entering information, retrieving data and preparing and distributing reports. May also be responsible for diagnosing and troubleshooting minor system errors and problems.
  
  

* undefined

7. Prepares delinquent chart count, prepares list of suspended providers and maintains suspension file.
  
  
8. Collects statistics to support credentialing, regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  
  
9. Ensures that quality and turnaround times are meeting established standards.
  
  
10. Distributes reports to providers as needed.
  
  
11. Performs medical record audits, as needed, to support hospital Quality Department activities.
  
  
12. Serves as a resource for providers in the record completion process and any other hospital-authorized personnel.
  
  
13. Assists the HIM coding team with identifying medical record deficiencies for coding and DNFB encounters.
  
  
14. Maintains knowledge of all policies and procedures, laws, regulations and accreditation standards regarding the legal health record.
  
  
15. Conduct other duties as requested by management.
  
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
1. High School Graduate or GED equivalent.
  
  
2. Certification as a Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or certification-eligible, preferred, normally achieved by successfully completing two-year college level coursework in an RHIT program.
  
  
3. Minimum of two (2) years experience in health information management, comparable physician office, clinic or hospital business office, customer service/office setting, or applicable college education required. Experience with electronic medical records required.
  
  
4. Previous experience with data analysis preferred.
  
  
5. Detail-oriented. Knowledge of medical terminology required.
  
  
6. Ability to use a standard desktop and windows-based computer system, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, the Internet and computer navigation. Ability to use other software as required to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
7. Well-developed communication skills, both written and oral. Able to communicate effectively with individuals and groups representing diverse perspectives. Understands when escalation of issues is necessary. Ability to train and educate co-workers.
  
  
8. Excellent organization skills and can perform several duties and functions related to the daily operations of health record completion and demonstrate excellent customer service skills.
  
  
PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS
  
  
1. Must be able to set and organize own work priorities and adapt to them as they change frequently.
  
  
2. Must possess the ability to comply with Trinity Health policies and procedures.
  
  
3. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with interruptions and perform detailed tasks.
  
  
4. Must be able to spend majority of work time utilizing a computer, monitor and keyboard.
  
  
5. Involves a wide array of physical activities, primarily walking, standing, balancing, sitting, squatting and reading.
  
  

* undefined

6. Must be able to effectively and efficiently work in a remote setting.
